_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV decroissante : NII = revenu principal banque, depots = funding core, prets = generation NII, NIM = profitabilite spread, efficiency ratio = discipline cout, total assets = scale.

kpis.signal: NII = revenu principal Citizens, baisse 2024 sous pression NIM
kpis.description_fr: Marge nette d'interets : difference entre interets percus sur prets/titres et interets verses sur depots. Pilier #1 du CA banque commerciale.
kpis.description_en: Net interest income: difference between interest earned on loans/securities and interest paid on deposits. Top revenue driver for commercial bank.

kpis.signal: Funding stable post-crise SVB 2023, base deposit diversifiee
kpis.description_fr: Total des depots clients (chequing, savings, money market, time). Funding low-cost qui alimente NII.
kpis.description_en: Total customer deposits (checking, savings, money market, time). Low-cost funding source feeding NII.

kpis.signal: Portefeuille en contraction discipline en 2024, CRE office sous surveillance
kpis.description_fr: Encours total prets commerciaux + retail (residentiel, auto, education). Generateur principal d'interest income.
kpis.description_en: Total commercial + retail loans outstanding (residential, auto, education). Primary interest income generator.

kpis.signal: Compression NIM en 2024 reflet pression depot cost, mais re-pricing actif
kpis.description_fr: NIM = NII / actifs porteurs d'interet moyens. Indicateur cle profitabilite spread banque.
kpis.description_en: NIM = NII / average interest-earning assets. Key spread profitability metric for a bank.

kpis.signal: Ratio degrade vs 2020-22 (NII bas), TOP program vise amelioration
kpis.description_fr: Couts d'exploitation / revenus. Plus bas = plus efficace. Sous 60% = excellent.
kpis.description_en: Operating expenses / revenue. Lower = better. Below 60% = excellent.

kpis.signal: Banque regionale majeure US, top-15 par actifs
kpis.description_fr: Bilan total. Mesure de la taille de la banque, base pour ratios reglementaires.
kpis.description_en: Total balance sheet. Bank size metric, base for regulatory ratios.
